_meta.shows: A five-node tree at the Space Center with three nodes unlocked, 4,854 science and a multi-parent node (Stability), each node carrying its description.
_meta.notes: Small hand-authored tree (not a live capture) used ONLY by the M3b career-detail golden dual-run (dual-run.test.tsx) and stream test (stream.test.tsx). career.status.tech.nodes (CareerViewProvider.BuildTechNodes) carries a description as of contract 14.1, read off the tech tree's own config, so the node detail's description line is drawn here from the real wire shape and not only from the legacy capture; the two halves of this file carry the same strings, since a node's flavour line does not depend on which producer sent it. The first two nodes carry parts, in the shape career.status.tech.nodes[].parts has on the wire. Includes a multi-parent node (stability) to exercise the same research-and-development edge shape the C# synthetic wire fixture covers.
